description.en: Checks whether a given equipment slot index is flagged as 'manip' (i.e. tied to a manipulable/manip character model, see CMND_CREATE_MANIP_CHARA) for the currently controlled character. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation.
Index of the equipment slot to check.
The manip-related value stored for that equipment slot (0/falsy if not applicable).

example.code:
// Check whether equipment slot 0 is tied to a manip character
local isManip = CMND_IS_EQUIPMENT_MANIP(0);
